_doc: Shared fixture for the default trade-price type (DefaultPriceTypes.defaultFor / default_price_type_for). Read by the Java, JS, Python and Rust tests; all four must agree on every case. Lists every ProductTypeProto value exactly once: each test also checks the case keys equal the generated enum's names, so a new product fails all four suites until it is classified here. price_type is a PriceTypeProto name, or "raises" when the product has no default (the create wrapper raises unless the caller passes price_type). Expected values come from this file only. See docs/adr/default_price_types.md.
